propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, cujus hodierna die praeconium Innocentes Martyres non loquendo,
sed moriendo confessi sunt: omnia in nobis vitiorum mala mortifica; ut
fidem tuam, quam lingua nostra loquitur, etiam moribus vita fateatur.
Per Dominum nostrum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

Dominum nostrum.

praesentis, quaesumus, vitae pariter et aeternae tribue conferre
subsidium. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum
vivit et regnat in unitate.
